{{Otheruses|Twin Suns}}
{{Citation}}
[[File:Tatooine3.png|thumb|right|250px|The twin suns of the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]]]]
A '''binary star system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in which two [[Star/Legends|stars]] [[Orbit/Legends|revolved]] around a common center of mass. [[Supernova/Legends|Supernovas]] were twice more likely to occur in binary star systems. Sometimes, however, the pair would be stable enough that [[Planet/Legends|planets]] would form around them, such as with the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]], [[Selvaris system/Legends|Selvaris system]] and the [[Abyss system]]. Such planets often orbited the binary star in a figure-of-eight fashion, as was the case with [[Byss (Abyssin)/Legends|Byss]]. Having two suns did not lead to an orbiting world being a hot and arid one, as was the case with [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] early in its planetary history. In [[25,793 BBY]], Tatooine was a lush and verdant world which was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Kumumgah/Legends|Kumumgah]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Force Storm 1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]]</ref> After defying their [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] masters, the planet was subject to an [[Bombardment of Tatooine|orbital bombardment]] as punishment that caused the [[Silica/Legends|silica]] in the soil to fuse and become [[Glass/Legends|glass]], which over [[Time/Legends|time]] became sand and caused a dramatic climate shift, resulting in Tatooine becoming a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>
